senses.gloss: m., pl. קִינְטוֹרִין (Κενταυροί) Centaurs, savages represented as half-horses and half-men.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> <he>ע״כ בצלם … ונבראו ק׳</he> up to that time (of Enosh) men were created in the (divine) image and likeness, thenceforward the generations degenerated, and centaurs were created (Ar. <he>וקַיְּנָן קנתורין</he> and he shaped them as centaurs); Yalk. Chr. 1072 <he>קנטרין</he> (corr. acc.).
